pages.heading: Cold Sweat effect
pages.body: Pack default: -0.2 base temperature for 60 seconds. Cools while the effect lasts. The latest KNCraft thermal meal replaces the previous effect. Normal hunger rules apply. Server settings and tooltips take precedence.
pages.fallback: Pack default: -0.2 base temperature for 60 seconds. Cools while the effect lasts. The latest KNCraft thermal meal replaces the previous effect. Normal hunger rules apply. Server settings and tooltips take precedence.

pages.heading: Aether Freezer
pages.body: Pack defaults: Freeze prepared juice for 10 seconds. Makes one smoothie; uses normal Freezer fuel.

pages.heading: Server machine recipe
pages.body: 10 seconds with normal machine fuel. Use JEI for the current ingredients and result.
